# Yuki Matsukura (松倉 友樹)

## Overview
Yuki Matsukura is a CTO and software engineer with over 20 years of experience building scalable systems and innovative solutions. Currently serving as CTO at Minedia Inc., a data technology startup that raised approximately ¥500M in funding. His career spans multiple high-growth companies including Metaps (developed SPIKE payment service) and GREE (managed social gaming platform).

## Current Position
- **Company**: Minedia Inc. (株式会社Minedia)
- **Role**: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
- **Period**: 2018 - Present
- **Responsibilities**:
  - Leading technology strategy and development for data technology startup
  - Raised approximately ¥500M in funding
  - Published research on regional EC data analysis (Springer, 2023)
  - Built and scaled engineering team to support business growth

## Featured Projects

### AI-Powered Tools

#### AI Moderator
- **URL**: https://ai-moderator.teraren.com/
- **Description**: Highly customizable content moderation system with multi-model architecture
- **Features**:
  - Flexible content moderation with customizable AI models
  - Multi-model architecture supporting OpenAI API and other AI models
  - Organization-specific system prompts and instructions
  - Featured in Nikkei newspaper
- **Tech Stack**: OpenAI API, Custom AI Models, React, Node.js

#### AI TRI+
- **URL**: https://ai-triathlon-result.teraren.com/
- **Description**: LLM-powered training plans and race result analysis platform for triathletes
- **Features**:
  - Database of 2,444+ Japanese triathlon events, 3.5M+ race results, and 1.25M+ athlete profiles (open source on GitHub)
  - Race analysis: rankings, percentile-based deviation scores, strength/weakness diagnostics, race reviews
  - LLM coach generating periodized training plans from 100+ data points, synced to Google/Apple Calendar
  - REST API with OpenAPI specification and MCP support for LLM assistants
  - Free tier plus Premium at roughly 1/200 of traditional coaching pricing
- **Tech Stack**: GPT / Gemini, MCP, OpenAPI, React, Python, Open Source Data

#### ESP32 Meeting Recorder
- **Write-up**: https://zenn.dev/minedia/articles/meeting-recorder-esp32
- **Description**: Self-built one-button recording device for meeting rooms. Speaker-diarized minutes are saved to Google Drive, and a summary with meeting metrics is posted to Slack
- **Features**:
  - ESP32-C3 SuperMini with microphone, OLED, and button, about ¥1,200 per unit; all inference runs in the cloud
  - Streams 10-second audio chunks to a Cloudflare Worker that passes them straight to R2, so load does not grow with meeting length
  - ElevenLabs Scribe for diarized transcription, Claude for structured summaries
  - About $0.29 per meeting hour with zero fixed cost (2026)
- **Tech Stack**: ESP32-C3, Cloudflare Workers, R2, ElevenLabs Scribe, Claude, Google Drive API, Slack

### API Services Collection

All APIs provide high-performance Japanese data services with modern REST & GraphQL support:

1. **Postcode API** (https://postcode.teraren.com/)
   - High-performance Japanese postal code lookup service
   - REST & GraphQL support, 90%+ test coverage
   - Multilingual (JP/EN), Cloudflare optimized

2. **Bank Code API** (https://bank.teraren.com/)
   - Japanese banking institution codes database
   - Complete bank code database with fast lookup

3. **Corporation API** (https://corporation.teraren.com/)
   - Company registration information
   - Corporate number search with company profile data

4. **Train & Station API** (https://train.teraren.com/)
   - Railway and station information database
   - Station search, railway line information, route planning data

5. **School API** (https://school.teraren.com/)
   - Educational institution database
   - School information lookup with institution classification

6. **Dam API** (https://dam.teraren.com/)
   - Nationwide Japanese dam database with specifications and location data

7. **Japanese Era API** (https://seireki.teraren.com/)
   - Japanese era name to Western calendar conversion and back

8. **Inkan Generator** (https://inkan.teraren.com/)
   - Browser-based Japanese seal (hanko) image generator

### Open Source Tools

1. **astro-affiliate-card / remark-affiliate-card** (https://github.com/matsubo/astro-affiliate-card)
   - Astro integration and remark plugin that render Amazon / Rakuten / Yahoo! Shopping product cards from a single ASIN directive
   - Product data is committed as JSON so builds never depend on an external API; published on npm in August 2026

2. **room-air-monitor** (https://github.com/matsubo/room-air-monitor)
   - ESP32-C3 + ESPHome office environment monitor: CO2, temperature, humidity, VOC/NOx indices, and noise pushed to InfluxDB every minute (2026)

3. **voice-memo-stt** (https://github.com/matsubo/voice-memo-stt)
   - Go CLI (vmt) that transcribes macOS Voice Memos with pluggable STT engines; CLI, TUI, and Alfred Workflow interfaces

4. **claude-code-max-usage** (https://github.com/matsubo/claude-code-max-usage)
   - Shows Claude Code (Max plan) usage as color-coded progress bars in tmux or Starship
